summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face—which surpassed 3 million public models by August 2026, though downloads remain highly concentrated (the top 200 models account for roughly half of all downloads)—and a growing layer of developer-facing inference platforms (Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, and others) that serve open-weight models via APIs or local runtimes. These platforms are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and managed MLOps suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open access, rapid prototyping, and cost-efficient inference. The space has also seen a notable surge in large open models from Chinese labs, with monthly parameter ceilings far exceeding most U.S. open releases.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints and serverless inference.
platforms.pricing: Free hosting/downloads; Pro at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints billed by compute/hour; Enterprise Hub for organizations; pay-as-you-go serverless inference.
features: Largest open model and dataset registry
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Model/dataset cards, versioning, and download stats
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and open-source developers who need discovery, distribution, collaboration, and flexible deployment of models.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A lightweight tool for running open LLMs locally on personal machines with a simple CLI and API, emphasizing privacy and offline use.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated open models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source for local use; costs limited to your own hardware; optional cloud/turbo offerings emerging.
features: One-command local model download and run
GGUF quantized model support for consumer GPUs/CPUs
Integrates with many local-first app frameworks
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want private, offline, local inference without cloud dependencies.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open models (especially image, video, audio, and LLMs) via simple API calls, with easy custom model packaging.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use by compute time (per-second GPU billing) or per output; no subscription required.
features: Run models via a simple HTTP/REST API
Cog framework for packaging/deploying custom models
Strong support for image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: Developers and product builders who want to integrate generative media and ML models quickly without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-weight LLMs, offering fast serverless APIs and dedicated GPU deployments.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; hourly pricing for dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters; fine-tuning billed by usage.
features: Optimized inference stack for low latency/high throughput
Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Broad catalog of chat, code, and embedding models
platforms.best_for: Startups and developers building production LLM applications on open models at scale with cost-efficient inference.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-focused inference platform for open LLMs and multimodal models, emphasizing low latency, high throughput, and production reliability.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand and reserved dedicated GPU deployments; fine-tuning available.
features: Function calling and structured/JSON output support
Fine-tuning (including LoRA) and custom model hosting
platforms.best_for: Teams needing fast, production-grade inference for open models with strong performance and tooling.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference platform (strong in the Chinese market) offering fast, low-cost access to a wide range of open-weight LLMs, image, and audio models.
platforms.model_count: Dozens to 100+ open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Llama, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage with competitive low pricing; free tiers/credits for some models; dedicated deployment options.
features: Strong support for leading Chinese open models
Text, image, and audio generation endpoints
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking affordable, fast access to Chinese and global open models.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely fast token generation for open LLMs.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of supported open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; generous free developer tier; enterprise plans available.
features: Industry-leading inference speed via LPU hardware
Very low latency for real-time applications
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time applications on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/router that provides access to hundreds of open and proprietary models from many providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across open and closed providers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (passes through provider pricing) with credits; no subscription; automatic routing to cheapest/fastest provider.
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic fallback and routing across providers
Transparent per-model pricing and usage tracking
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
Rapid availability of newly released models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access and easy model switching without multiple integrations.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: A serverless cloud platform for running and deploying custom AI/ML workloads and open models with Python-native infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Unlimited (user-deployed); run any open model on-demand
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use by compute (per-second GPU/CPU billing); free starter credits.
features: Deploy custom models and inference endpoints
platforms.best_for: ML engineers who want to deploy custom open-model workloads and inference without managing servers.
